param.name: create_gdb
param.displayname: Create Output GDB If It Does Not Exist

param.name: fc_filter
param.displayname: Feature Classes to Import (leave blank = ALL)

param.name: existing_action
param.displayname: If Feature Class Already Exists in Output GDB
param.expression: {APPEND - add features to existing layer (merge cells) | OVERWRITE - replace existing layer, then merge new cells | SKIP - keep existing, skip import}

param.name: add_to_map
param.displayname: Add Imported Layers to Active Map

param.name: group_layers
param.displayname: Group Layers by GDB Name in Map

param.name: theme_filter
param.expression: {CCM-Relevant Only (Soil / Vegetation / Hydrography / Transportation / Elevation / Physiography) | Soil | Vegetation | Hydrography | Transportation | Elevation | Physiography | Culture | Boundary | Aeronautical | Military | Other}

param.name: group_by_theme
param.displayname: Group Layers by Theme in Map (overrides Group by GDB Name)

param.name: assume_wgs84
param.displayname: Assume WGS84 (EPSG:4326) for Sources With Unknown CRS (MGCP data is WGS84 — repairs missing .prj)

param.name: data_root
param.displayname: Data Root Folder (optional — scans subfolders and auto-fills the empty inputs above)
